verses.mystical_translation: Holy Presence, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
Many there be which say of my whole being, There is no help for him in the Divine. Selah.
But thou, O the Living Presence, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
I cried unto the Living Presence with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Living Presence sustained me.
I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
deliverance and wholeness belongeth unto the Living Presence: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

contemplative_note: Even under pressure, the body can sleep when trust becomes a shield.
safety_note: Enemy language belongs to a personal lament and must not be mapped onto living groups. Violent imagery is prayer-poetry, not a directive to attack people.
